io.milvus.telemetry

Class ClientTelemetryManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.telemetry.ClientTelemetryManager
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AutoCloseable

    public final class ClientTelemetryManager
extends Object
implements AutoCloseable
    Collects client operation metrics and exchanges heartbeat commands with Milvus.

    The manager is thread-safe. Command replies remain queued until a heartbeat succeeds, and persistent command hashes are deterministic across SDK languages.

      • beginRuntimeStateRetirement

        public long beginRuntimeStateRetirement()
        Invalidates an in-flight heartbeat and prevents another one from starting while the surrounding connection switch is pending. The token can be cancelled if that switch rolls back, without making the old manager unusable.
        Returns:
        the retirement token to use with cancelRuntimeStateRetirement(long) and handoffRuntimeStateTo(ClientTelemetryManager, long)

      • cancelRuntimeStateRetirement

        public void cancelRuntimeStateRetirement(long retirementToken)

        Parameters:
        retirementToken - the token returned by beginRuntimeStateRetirement()
